title: A location connected to QuickBooks gets one empty row per category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new organization created on the build.
  • Connect the organization's location to a QuickBooks Online company.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The QuickBooks page opens.

Step 2:

  • Four category rows show, General Internal, Warranty, Goodwill and Comeback, each empty and with no hint while the setting is off.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11762 (Story 5, QuickBooks Online account mapping), story SV-12295 (Story 13, Release day, seeding and migration)

  • S13-R2: “The same migration creates one empty ShopView Accounts row per category at every location with a connected QuickBooks company (S5-R5); the rows carry no hint while the setting is off. A location connected later gets its rows when the connection is made, as other rows do.”
  • S5-R5: “The rows are shown whether or not the Internal Work Orders setting is on, so the accountant can map ahead of time.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
